One row per VOC interview (Won/Loss and Discovery) showing how it ties to Salesforce. voc_vw_sf_opportunities keeps only deals closed 2021-01-01 to today, so this view reads raw Salesforce to place interviews on open, older or future-dated deals, and interviews with only an account, in a segment and region. Use it to find interviews inside a Salesforce population; never use it to count deals or win rates.
